v4.6.145 — DAY bot now honours "Min positions to hold"

🎯 Your DAY bot's "Min positions to hold" setting actually works now. Before, the DAY bot ignored it — it only ever opened ONE position per run (the single best AI pick) and frequently skipped, so it sat at 0–1 positions no matter what you set. The floor was only ever wired into the LONG and SHORT bots.

Now the DAY bot fills up to your minimum the same way LONG does: when it's holding fewer than your minimum, it deploys the top-ranked candidates as brackets WITHOUT waiting for AI approval, until the floor is reached (or it runs out of candidates / buying power). Each floor position still gets its own ATR stop-loss and take-profit, and the floor never exceeds your "Max concurrent positions" cap. The AI-picked discretionary entry still runs on top to add a name above the floor.

Set it per bot under the DAY bot's settings — 0 = fully cautious (old one-at-a-time behaviour), 5 = always stay invested in the top-ranked names (default).

Update via the in-app banner.
